title: Classify a quartic by sign · Set 2
statement:
Find the local maximum value of $f(x)=-x^4+2([$a])x^2$, given that it has symmetric maxima.

[__________]{a}
hints: Substitute $x^2=a$ to find their common height.
solution: $f'=4x([$a]-x^2)$ changes from positive to negative at each of $x=\pm\sqrt{[$a]}$. The value is $-[$a]^2+2[$a]^2=[$a]^2$.
